author: DonaldMyTrump
body: Hey guys, I got banned on TS again. This time for impersonating a staff member. I didn't impersonate the staff member, Newcleus as I neither display named myself to Newcleus or any other ign that Michael/Newcleus identifies with. I also didn't tell any staff members or players that I was Newcleus/Michael and therefore the ban is inaccurate. The Senior who banned me (GrapeSmoothie) claimed that it was because I asked for senior mod while I was on an identity that Michael had previously used. This statement is inaccurate though since I was the only person using this account as staff had clearly made an effort to not give that identity senior mod (as admitted by GrapeSmoothie himself). Therefore the identity was an account that staff, the community and myself made efforts to spread awareness of my ownership of it. There is no evidence supporting the idea that I intended to impersonate Michael due to my lack of identifying myself as Michael or any other staff member, the fact that I am widely known for my support and love of John Cena and have been known to don his name as my display name on TS and the fact that I was at the time the sole user of this identity since Michael was specifically using one I would not have access to. Please respond as soon as possible. Thanks.
